title: Vietnamese-Style Braised Lamb Chops
description: A hearty and flavorful Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring lamb chops slow-cooked in a rich bo kho sauce.

ingredients.name: Bo kho sauce (see notes)
ingredients.notes: Homemade bo kho sauce recipe: 2 tablespoons fish sauce, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 2 cloves garlic minced, 1 tablespoon grated ginger, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cups lamb or beef broth

ingredients.name: Loin of beef (optional)
ingredients.notes: For added flavor and texture, thinly slice and add to braising liquid

instructions: 2. In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add lamb chops and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
4. Remove lamb chops from pot and set aside.
5. Reduce heat to medium and cook bo kho sauce ingredients in the same pot, stirring constantly, until fragrant and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
6. Add lamb chops back to pot, cover with lid, and transfer to preheated oven.
7. Braise lamb chops for 2-3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
8. Serve lamb chops with additional bo kho sauce spooned over the top.
9. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with steamed rice or noodles.
10. If using beef loin, add it to the braising liquid during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
